mechanism: Level-1 radial-coordinate branch: a behaviour signal computed once from the TRAINING sequences (popularity-adjusted directed out-degree s_i) places every item i at a per-item radius r_i = R tanh(min(log(1+s_i),T_max)/(2R)) inside a Poincare ball of curvature kappa = -1/R^2, R = max(1, log(N_items)/log(1+max(b_bar,1.1))), b_bar = mean_i s_i. Per training step the encoder output z is L2-normalised, pushed to u_i = r_i * zhat, and compared against every level-1 codeword e_k transported to the same ball (rho_k = R tanh(||e_k||/(2R)), c_k = rho_k * e_k/max(||e_k||,eps)) with the Poincare distance d_k = arcosh(1 + 2 R^2 ||u_i - c_k||^2 / max((R^2-||u_i||^2)(R^2-||c_k||^2), 1e-6 R^4)); the level-1 token is k1 = argmin_k d_k, the codebook itself stays Euclidean so z_q1 = e_{k1}, the residual res_1 = z - z_q1 and all deeper levels (2..L) run the unchanged baseline Euclidean residual-VQ argmin with no curvature and no Sinkhorn. Loss, decoder, interface and straight-through are the baseline RQ-VAE ones; the metric only decides which integer k1 is emitted, carrying no gradient, so gradients reach z exactly as in the baseline straight-through path.

computations.name: pair_counts
computations.definition: n_ij = #{(a,b) : a = i and b = j at consecutive positions of one TRAINING-split sequence}
computations.output: N x N integer count matrix (sparse, directed, self-pairs not counted)
computations.note: precomputed once, frozen before the first step

computations.name: item_marginals
computations.definition: n_i = sum_j n_ij ; n_j = sum_i n_ij
computations.note: directed counts

computations.name: adjusted_successors
computations.definition: S_i = { j : n_ij > n_i * n_j / M }
computations.note: strict >; co-consumption above the popularity-only expectation

computations.name: branching_mean
computations.note: N = N_items

computations.name: behaviour_signal
computations.note: the behaviour signal; frozen buffer

computations.name: catalogue_mean_T
computations.note: used when USE_BEHAV=False

computations.name: curvature_radius
computations.note: N_items = 24556

computations.name: curvature
computations.note: constant, never trained

computations.name: clamp_bound
computations.note: keeps r_i strictly inside the ball

computations.name: radius_table
computations.definition: T_i_eff = T_i if USE_BEHAV else T_bar ; r_i = R * tanh(min(T_i_eff, T_max) / (2*R))
computations.note: switch 1 enters here; r_i < R always

computations.name: normalise_query
computations.note: differentiable but upstream of the argmin only

computations.name: transport_query
computations.definition: u_i = r_i * zhat_i  (USE_CURV=True) ; u_i = T_i_eff * zhat_i  (USE_CURV=False)
computations.note: switch 2 enters here; for USE_CURV=True ||u_i|| < R

computations.name: code_radius
computations.note: rho_k < R

computations.name: code_transport
computations.definition: c_k = rho_k * e_k / max(||e_k||, eps)  (USE_CURV=True) ; c_k = ||e_k|| * e_k / max(||e_k||, eps)  (USE_CURV=False)
computations.note: E1 itself is unchanged and stays Euclidean

computations.name: level1_distance
computations.definition: diff2_k = ||u_i - c_k||_2^2 ; den_k = max((R^2 - ||u_i||^2) * (R^2 - ||c_k||^2), 1e-6 * R^4) ; d_k = arcosh(1 + 2*R^2*diff2_k/den_k)  (USE_CURV=True) ; d_k = ||u_i - c_k||_2  (USE_CURV=False)
computations.note: guard 1e-6 R^4 keeps arcosh real; no clip, no temperature

computations.name: level1_assignment
computations.note: carries no gradient; decides the token

computations.name: level1_quantized
computations.note: Euclidean codeword, not c_{k1} and not u_i

computations.name: residual_level1
computations.note: baseline formula, unchanged

computations.name: deep_levels
computations.definition: for l = 2..L: k_l = argmin_k ||res_{l-1} - e^{(l)}_k||_2 ; res_l = res_{l-1} - e^{(l)}_{k_l}
computations.note: exactly baseline: no curvature, no Sinkhorn, no radii

computations.name: straight_through
computations.output: B x d fed to the decoder
computations.note: identity in the backward

computations.name: total_loss
computations.note: baseline RQ-VAE loss, unmodified; no extra term

computations.name: switch_behaviour
computations.definition: USE_BEHAV in {True, False} ; T_i_eff = T_i if USE_BEHAV else (T_bar for all i)
computations.note: one flag; not trained in this round

computations.name: switch_geometry
computations.definition: USE_CURV in {True, False} : True -> Poincare branch of radius_table/transport/code_transport/level1_distance ; False -> kappa->0 branch (u_i = T_i_eff*zhat_i, rho_k = ||e_k||, c_k = ||e_k||*ehat_k, d_k = ||u_i - c_k||_2)
computations.output: the distance block used by the argmin
computations.note: one flag; not trained in this round

inputs: level-1 codebook E1 (256 x d, Euclidean, unchanged)
frozen per-item radii r (24556 float32) and T_i_eff (24556 float32)
target x and decoder D for the baseline loss
outputs: the Euclidean codeword e_{k1} (B x d) used for the straight-through reconstruction and subtracted from the residual handed to the baseline deep levels
deep levels' k_l and the summed codeword to the decoder (baseline format)
no change to any deeper level's interface, to the decoder, or to the Stage-3 input format
parameters: n_ij, n_i, n_j, M (frozen count tables)
E1 (256 x d) trainable, baseline init
E_l (l >= 2) and decoder D trainable, baseline
